frozen_before: any model in this study was fitted or scored
market_family: CBB full-game lines: winner, point spread, total points (Division I games with an ESPN team box)
prediction_cutoff: scheduled tip; features use games on strictly earlier dates
labels: final score from the certified dataset. Kalshi official CBB results are not joined (1,047 exchange events lack a team-identity join; ladder strike semantics changed between 2025 and 2026): contract-level scoring is deferred
baseline: adjusted_efficiency = walk-forward ridge on opponent-adjusted offence / defence / net, games played, neutral flag and home-court value

hypotheses.claim: adding conference_strength to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin
adding conference_strength to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of total
adding four_factors_defence to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin
adding four_factors_defence to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of total
adding four_factors_offence to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin
adding four_factors_offence to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of total
adding tempo to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of margin
adding tempo to the adjusted-efficiency reference lowers out-of-sample squared error of total

multiple_testing: Holm across all 8 hypotheses on the TEST seasons (alpha 0.05)
not_claimed: no market comparison (no historical CBB line or Kalshi quote history in the vault); no betting value
holdout_rule: 2026 and 2027 season outcomes are blanked before any fit unless --holdout; one-shot
